'''1 ABY''' was the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]].

==Events==
*36:8:4&mdash;A court of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sentences [[Earnst Kamiel]], a founding member of the [[Justice Action Network]], to death by firing squad.<ref name="GNN8" />
*36:8:22&mdash;As law enforcement authorities close in on a cell of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Calamar]] on [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] suffers a nearly total blackout as power is shut down at the [[Calamar Power Plant]] when the plant computer receives a direct order to shut down the Calamar grid, allowing the Rebels to escape. At the urging of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Jander Graffe]], [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Griff Takel]] forms a committee to investigate suspicions that Rebel spies infiltrated the office of Calamar's mayor.<ref name="GNN8" />
*36:10:4&mdash;Earnst Kamiel is executed by a firing squad that includes marksmen from each of the 54 [[Star system/Legends|systems]] where he received the death penalty.<ref name="GNN8" />
*37:F1:1&mdash;Launch of [[New Year Fete Week/Legends|New Year Fete Week]].<ref name="GNN8">{{JournalCite|8|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
*37:F1:3&mdash;Victory of the [[Esselian New Order Party|New Order Party]] at the [[Esselian Hall election, 2 ABY|Esselian Hall election]].<ref name="GNN8" />
*37:2:21&mdash;15% increase in taxes to all [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] citizens.<ref name="GNN9">{{JournalCite|9|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
*[[Spira Regatta Open]].<ref name="GNN5">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
*[[Spira Heist]].<ref name="GNN6">{{JournalCite|6|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
*''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' was completed at [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] under the name ''Executor II'' and was buried on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
*[[Ring Base]] in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]], [[Thila Command]] on [[Thila/Legends|Thila]] and [[Tak Base]] on [[Talay/Legends|Talay]] were invaded by the Galactic Empire, which forced the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] to evacuate all three command centers.
*[[Pter Thanas]] was reassigned to the new Imperial garrison at [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].
*[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] became the [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] after winning a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game against [[Dominic Raynor]].
*[[Sintas Vel]] disappeared while on a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] mission before being [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|frozen]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] for [[40 ABY/Legends|39 years]]. [[Ailyn Vel|Her daughter]] presumed her to be [[Death/Legends|dead]].
*[[Nym's Anniversary Bash]] was held in [[Nym's Stronghold]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].<ref name="SWG:NGE" />
*Imperial [[Blockade of Kashyyyk (1 ABY)|blockade]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="SWHS" /><ref name="date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15778940|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-12|time=6:13 PM|quote=Wookiee Life Day occurs every 3 years, one of which fell at ~1.5 ABY.}}</ref>
*Imperial curfew of the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]].
*Construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] began over an unknown [[Planet/Legends|world]].
*[[Nova Orion Crisis]].<ref name="SWG:NGE">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>
*The [[Dark Trooper Project]] was canceled after the ''[[Arc Hammer]]'' was destroyed by [[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Jan Ors]].<ref name="DF" />
*[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] made a speech in front of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:NGE" />
*[[Cleansing of Shalyvane]]<ref name="The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>
*Serious criminal threats on Naboo were eradicated, thanks to the efforts of a lone [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] member.<ref name="SWG:NGE">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>
*A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] was deemed the Hero of the [[Corellian Security Force]] for their efforts in eradicating a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] trade on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:NGE" />
*A spacer discovered and eradicated the [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] [[Arachne]]&mdash; an enhanced [[Species/Legends|species]] of arachnoid native to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. They would have utterly destroyed the ecosystem on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG:NGE" />
*[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], reborn as [[N-K Necrosis]], was destroyed deep in the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] by a group of spacers on Kashyyyk.<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>
*Numerous remnants of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] era were investigated on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] by spacers.<ref name="SWG:ToOW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref>
*The [[Avatar Orbital Platform]] was assaulted by a group of spacers in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" />
*An Imperial [[Prison/Legends|prison]] and research facility on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] became overrun with the [[Zombie/Legends|undead]].<ref name="SWG:NGE" />
*[[Axkva Min]], an exiled [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]], and her [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] attempted to escape from the [[Chamber of Banishment]] on Dathomir. They were killed by a group of spacers.<ref name="SWG:NGE" />
*[[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]] was defeated by a group of spacers as he attempted to raise a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Army/Legends|army]] on Lok.<ref name="SWG:NGE" />
*A group of spacers saved [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] from an invading [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] army.<ref name="SWG:NGE" />
*[[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] essence and his [[Cult of Exar Kun|cult]] were defeated by a group of spacers within the depths of his ancient [[Temple of Exar Kun|temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Kun was not yet completely destroyed.<ref name="SWG:NGE" />
*A group of spacers infiltrated an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]] that had been hijacked by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and the traitorous [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Andal Sait]] and his [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. The remaining Imperial crew was rescued and the traitors defeated.<ref name="SWG:NGE" />
*[[HK-47]] was discovered to be still alive, inside the [[Memory bank/Legends|memory core]] of a downed Galactic Republic [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] on Mustafar. He manipulated a group of spacers to free him and raise a droid army. He was later thwarted, but escaped.<ref name="SWG:ToOW" />
*36:4&mdash;Destruction of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Brazen]]'' by Rebel forces.<ref name="OE">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref>
*[[Aerie Casino opening]].<ref name="ROD">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''</ref>
*[[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] [[Wedding of Soontir Fel and Wynssa Starflare|marries]] [[Syal Antilles Fel|Wynssa Starflare]].<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
*The [[Bounty Hunter Wars]] start.<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>
